dedupe_keys.name: istadfuels italian spatiotemporal augmented dataset on fuels

description: Alessio Chiodin and Paolo Maranzano publish ISTADFuels for analysing and forecasting fuel sales across Italian provinces. Version 3 covers January 2015 through October 2023 at monthly frequency and NUTS3 geographic resolution. Records distinguish fuel type, usage and point of sale, including highway, municipal-road and extra-network sales. Socioeconomic and geographic variables accompany sales to support spatiotemporal demand forecasting, urban-mobility analysis and related modelling. The authors combine the Italian environment ministry oil bulletin with ISTAT, Bank of Italy and Eurostat sources, cleaning and reshaping the inputs into long-format panel data. A limitation is that annual or spatially coarser variables are repeated across dates or locations; they are not independently observed at every monthly provincial point. The public BOARD repository lists CSV data and metadata plus documentation, under CC BY 4.0 without a stated charge. A linked Shiny application and GitHub repository provide exploration routes, which were not executed or read. The release was published in January 2024; update frequency is not stated. Exact sales units and complete field definitions remain in uninspected metadata files. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.

discovery_routes.query: Saved BOARD 159-member native inventory; full exact member metadata supports fuel-demand forecasting under current energy-system scope.
